metadata.title: Puerto Princesa City Annual Budget History
metadata.description: Total new appropriations approved by the City Government of Puerto Princesa, by fiscal year.
metadata.source: Annual Budgets and Annual Budget Report, City Government of Puerto Princesa (Full Disclosure Board)
metadata.note: 2022's source workbook has a broken grand-total cell (a display-overflow artifact, not a real value); that year's figure is computed by summing its sectoral breakdown instead. Budgets do not always increase year over year — dips in 2021 and 2023 reflect real swings in one-time/supplemental appropriations, not a data error.
